label: Default branch
when: the view is rendered at the repository's default branch, which a toss at main also is

label: Off-branch
when: a toss, or a ?use= address the page honors, renders the view at another branch or at a commit

label: At rest
when: no text is selected, and the view is at the default branch

label: Text selected
when: text is selected anywhere on the page, or in the page a toss frames; outranks every other glyph, and a ring surrounds the FAB
note: opens the FAB sidebar on its Note tab, with the passage quoted

label: Off-branch
when: the view is off the default branch, and no text is selected

label: No token
when: this browser holds no GitHub token; an iOS home-screen app keeps a token store of its own, apart from Safari
note: a hold on the FAB opens its menu, whose Get token and Paste token rows fetch and save one

label: Newer commits
when: the view's address names a commit, a token is saved, and the branch the link names (else the branch of an open pull request holding the commit) is ahead; the count is how many commits
note: redraws the view at the branch's latest commit

label: Takeover
when: a takeover is open over the view, and no text is selected; outranks the frisbee, so the tint alone says off-branch while a takeover is open
note: opens the FAB sidebar, aimed at the takeover

label: Latest
when: the view's address names a commit, a token is saved, and the check found the branch still at that commit; shown only after a check ran
note: opens the FAB sidebar on its ref bar

label: Frisbee, drawn
when: as the frisbee, which it would replace
